# NOIR

[![build](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Verlintas/NOIR)](https://github.com/Verlintas/NOIR/releases)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Verlintas/NOIR)](LICENSE)
![platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platforms-macOS%20%7C%20Windows%20%7C%20Linux-2ea44f)
[![AtomGit](https://img.shields.io/badge/AtomGit-Verlintas%2FNOIR-2f81f7)](https://atomgit.com/Verlintas/NOIR)

**把「这台手机到底能泄露什么」变成一份可复现的报告。**

NOIR 是一个跑在电脑上的审计工具，通过 `adb` 读取已连接 Android 设备的应用清单、权限和 APK 里的网络端点，给出分类、风险评分和可执行的处置建议。它也可以在需要时调用 `jadx` 对单个应用做反编译和关键字检索。

> 定位：**审计与自我防护**。面向自己的设备、自己的应用、已授权的安全研究。

**官网 / Website:** https://verlintas.dev/noir/ · [中文](https://verlintas.dev/noir/zh/)

**AtomGit 镜像 / Mirror:** https://atomgit.com/Verlintas/NOIR

---

## 它做什么

1. **盘点**：列出所有「有网络权限 + 敏感权限」的应用，以及它们各自拿到了什么。
2. **抽取端点**：在设备端用 `unzip + strings` 从每个 APK 的 dex 里提取 URL，只回传几 KB，不把整包拉回电脑。
3. **分类与打分**：按包名和域名识别厂商（Xiaomi / Google / 腾讯 / 高德 …）与类别（遥测、广告、定位、输入法 …），结合权限和上报端点计算风险分。
4. **数据关联**：把权限翻译成"能拿到什么数据"（位置/通讯录/短信/通话/麦克风/相机/屏幕/应用列表/设备标识/文件/日历/账号），再和上报域名配对，得出"哪类数据可能流向哪里"。
5. **共享 UID**：识别 `android.uid.system` 这类共享用户，列出哪些包实际上共享同一套权限并集。
6. **清单层**：解析 `AndroidManifest.xml` 二进制 AXML，找出没有权限保护的导出组件、明文流量、备份、debuggable、targetSdk。
4. **给建议**：区分「可安全自动执行」「需人工确认」「不建议动」，并为每条动作生成回滚命令。
5. **必要时深挖**：`deep` 会把单个 APK 拉到本地，用 `jadx` 反编译后检索 `Runtime.exec`、`setApplicationEnabledSetting`、`DexClassLoader`、`MediaProjection` 等高风险调用。

## 它不做什么

- 不联网、不上传任何数据、不需要账号。
- 不修改系统分区

# 水杉输入法

**简体中文** · [English](docs/readme/README.en.md) · [日本語](docs/readme/README.ja.md) · [한국어](docs/readme/README.ko.md) · [繁體中文](docs/readme/README.zh-Hant.md)

### 打中文，候选旁就是英文。

打开「显示英文释义」后，查得到释义的候选旁会标出英文。在电脑上再打开「候选词翻译」，按 Ctrl+Enter 上屏的就是高亮候选的英文：只有一条释义时直接上屏，有几条时先列出来让你选。

```text
你打的       候选窗里            按 Ctrl+Enter 上屏
yusuan   →  预算   budget    →  budget
zhoumo   →  周末   weekend   →  weekend
```

**[下载水杉输入法](https://msime.app/download/)** · Windows · macOS · Linux · Android · iOS · HarmonyOS · 免费开源（GPL-3.0-only）

- **怎么打开**：默认都是关的。在设置里打开「显示英文释义」（Android 和 iOS 上叫「离线英文释义」），想看读音再开「显示读音」：英文释义标音标，日文和韩文释义标罗马字，法、西、俄、德释义标国际音标（德语给实际读音）。释义和读音查本机词库，显示时不联网（Android、iOS 和 Linux 上英文音标词典和法日西俄德韩的外语读音词典各要在设置里下载一次）；「候选词翻译」不选在线翻译服务时也只查本机词库。
- **还有什么**：「候选词翻译」的目标语言还可以换成法、日、西、俄、德、韩（鸿蒙手机上没有俄语）；「背单词」内置中考到 GRE 八本词书，按间隔重复排复习。
- **平台差异**：读音目前在 macOS、Linux、Android、iOS、鸿蒙和 Windows 新版预览上显示；Windows 正式版由 [msime-windows](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime-windows) 发布，没有单独的「显示英文释义」开关，打开「候选词翻译」就会显示离线英文释义，也能用 Ctrl+Enter，暂时没有音标，也没有按间隔重复排复习的「背单词」词书；手机版仍是测试版。

**输入法能看到你输入的一切，所以这个问题应该有一个能逐条核对的答案：[哪些数据会离开设备](PRIVACY.md)。**简短版本：新装的默认配置下没有功能会把你输入的内容发出设备；云联想（把正在组的拼音发给 Google 输入工具）要你在首次询问或设置里打开，其余联网功能都要你自己填凭据或选择服务才会工作。另有一条不携带输入内容的自有匿名使用统计：六个平台都会向 `api.msime.app` 发送每日活跃、会话和崩溃（错误摘要与去掉目录的调用栈）记录，默认开启，可以在设置的「匿名使用统计」里关闭——字段、逐平台差异和落盘位置逐条列在 [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md#使用统计与崩溃上报默认开启可关闭)。仓库不接入任何第三方统计或崩溃上报 SDK。

水杉输入法（MSIME）是面向 Android、iOS、macOS、Linux、Windows 与 HarmonyOS 的多平台中文输入法。六个平台各有自己的原生输入法宿主，都接入同一套共享输入运行时；设置界面按平台归属：macOS、Linux 与 HarmonyOS 用同一份共享 React 设置页，Windows、iOS 与 Android 用各自的原生设置界面，设置的业务规则应当放在共享的 Rust 层、各平台界面只做界面（目前还有部分规则写在原生界面里）；React 设置页在 macOS 与 Linux 上通过 Tauri 调用普通 Rust 业务库，在 HarmonyOS 上不经过 Tauri，由 ArkWeb 加载、经 ArkTS 原生桥与 NAPI 调用 Rust；输入算法由 msime-engine 提供。

Eleven is a reverse-engineering app built around agents. Drop in an app, a binary, an Android APK, a GPU kernel, a shader or a model and ask what it does. Any agent that speaks the [Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) can read the code, follow references, rename functions, leave notes and suggest patches, while you watch and approve in the same window. Native code is read by [Ghidra](https://ghidra-sre.org) through [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea), or by [Rizin](https://rizin.re) when you want files to open in seconds. # Fonte **Open-source app updater for Android.**
Installs and updates apps straight from their source. Fast, private and minimal. No trackers, no Google Play Services. [![Android 15+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-15%2B-3DDC84?logo=android&logoColor=white)](#build) [![GrapheneOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/GrapheneOS-ready-1B6E7A)](#security) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Turtlecute33/Fonte?include_prereleases&color=1B6E7A)](https://github.com/Turtlecute33/Fonte/releases) [![License: GPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL--3.0-blue)](LICENSE)
## About Fonte keeps the apps that you install from outside an app store up to date. Give it a link to a repository or an app page. Fonte finds the latest release, picks the APK for your phone, checks it and installs it. It is an alternative to Obtainium, with fewer features and a smaller attack surface, and it imports your Obtainium list. Fonte has no native code, no WebView and no dynamic code loading. It is made to run on GrapheneOS with "Restrict dynamic code loading" (memory and storage) on. ## Features - **Sources**: GitHub (also private repositories, with a token), GitLab (also self-hosted), Codeberg, Forgejo and Gitea, F-Droid and IzzyOnDroid, and other F-Droid repos (for example the Guardian Project repo). Give the repo link with its fingerprint, then choose the app. - **The right APK**: the build for your processor, an optional name filter (regex), and pre-releases if you want them. - **Background updates**: a check every 3, 6, 12 or 24 hour

# PassPony (Android)

[![CI](https://github.com/norsehorse-dev/PassPonyAndroid/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/norsehorse-dev/PassPonyAndroid/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

A password manager that speaks pass and passage: plain encrypted files,
your keys, git sync. Kotlin and Jetpack Compose over the shared Rust core
([PassPonyCore](https://github.com/norsehorse-dev/passponycore)), the
same core that backs [PassPony iOS](https://github.com/norsehorse-dev/passpony).

Built packet by packet against the plan in `PLAN.md` and `docs/plan/`; see
that directory for how each feature below landed. The v1 feature set below
is implemented and CI-green; release engineering (packaging, storefront
listings, the signed release flow) is the packet in progress now -- see
`docs/plan/P16-release.md` and `docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md`.

- Browse, search, and edit entries in pass (OpenPGP) and passage (age)
  stores. Each format keeps its own store; switching never touches the
  other store's data.
- One-time codes: scan a QR code, paste an otpauth link, or type the
  key; live codes with a countdown ring. Reads and writes the same
  `otpauth://` line as pass-otp, including entries made with
  `pass otp insert`. Counter-based (HOTP) codes advance and commit the
  counter the way `pass otp code` does.
- Import from Google Authenticator: scan its export QR codes and each
  account becomes its own one-time code entry.
- Password generator with length and character-class options; the
  untouched default is pass's own 25 from the full set.
- Import an existing age identity for passage stores, plaintext or
  passphrase-protected (the `age -p` format gopass's age backend writes,
  binary or armored); the passphrase is asked for on import and the file
  is decrypted on the device.
